doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Revisiting the 1934 Purcell's photo and North Beach
summary: Looking at a Barbary Coast book photo, Alley recalls the Parenti North Beach job and meeting movie stars.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well I’m looking at this book here, “Jazz on the Barbary Coast.” It’s got a picture from 1934 at Purcell’s.
Yeah. That’s the guy that said we couldn’t play in North Beach in those days. And this guy said “they’re going to play there.” It wasn’t my band. I played with another guy.
Yeah. That’s when Edwin Lowe and Lilyan Tashman, the first movie stars I’ve ever seen, came in the place.
Wow. That’s really interesting. I love it. That’s history you know.
